concept: EMR: managed Spark/HBase clusters with fine-grained tuning
tests: Choosing a platform for petabyte-scale processing on a long-running Spark/HBase cluster with Spot for task nodes.
expected: Amazon EMR — managed Hadoop/Spark/HBase, long-running clusters, fine-grained framework tuning, Spot for task nodes. Triggers: "petabyte-scale", "long-running cluster", "HBase", "fine-grained tuning", "Spot task nodes".
why_not: Glue is serverless ETL without cluster control or HBase; Athena is serverless SQL on S3; Managed Flink (KDA) is real-time streaming.
